en.summary: This commit fixes the DRL accumulator by sign-extending every 25-bit addend to the full accumulator width and by sizing the CSA tree to that full signed width.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly names an accumulator bug.
The RTL patch directly changes arithmetic width and sign-extension behavior inside the accumulator module.
The accompanying unit-test changes compute and log the full accumulator budget, which is consistent with a real arithmetic-correctness fix.
evidence: hw/rtl/tcu/drl/VX_tcu_drl_acc.sv adds parameter W for the accumulator width and widens sigOut to W bits.
Each 25-bit input addend is explicitly sign-extended into sigsIn_ext before the CSA tree.
VX_csa_tree is re-parameterized from W = 25 to W = W with S = W - 1, so the reduction tree now operates on the full accumulator width.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A multi-operand signed accumulator must widen each incoming signed partial sum to the final accumulator width before reduction. If the design accumulates narrow signed operands without sign extension, or if the carry-save tree itself remains at the operand width instead of the accumulator width, negative terms and large positive sums are reduced incorrectly. This is a classic signed-width bug in reduction arithmetic.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: Signed partial-sum widening before CSA accumulation
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The accumulator receives negative addends or a set of inputs whose true sum requires more width than a single operand.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Feed narrow signed addends into the reduction tree without widening them, and keep the tree width tied to the operand width rather than to the accumulator width.
portability_notes: Map this to any compressor tree, CSA tree, or reduction adder that sums multiple signed partial products.
The essential bug is width mismatch between operand interpretation and accumulator budget.
This fault is most visible on negative partial sums or worst-case magnitude combinations.
concrete_injection_steps: Remove explicit sign extension from each signed addend before it enters the multi-operand reduction structure.
Parameterize the CSA or compressor tree with the raw operand width instead of the full accumulator width.
Keep the output interface width wider than the tree inputs so the arithmetic error appears as wrong sign or wrong magnitude rather than as an interface truncation artifact.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DRL significand accumulator sign extension and CSA-tree width
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix sign-extends each 25-bit addend to a computed accumulator width W and makes the CSA tree operate over that full width.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_tcu_drl_acc.sv, remove sigsIn_ext and feed raw 25-bit sigsIn into the tree, then restore the tree parameters toward W = 25 instead of the full accumulator width.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The accumulator produces the wrong sign or magnitude, especially when summing negative partial products or when the true sum exceeds the narrow operand width.
evidence_for_injection: The fix adds a dedicated accumulator-width parameter rather than only changing comments or tests.
The only new datapath logic before the tree is sign extension, which clearly marks the missing arithmetic behavior.
The tree width change from fixed 25 bits to W bits confirms the previous reduction width was insufficient.
notes: This is a very direct reverse-patch candidate because the arithmetic mutation is localized to one module.
Use tests with negative addends and near worst-case accumulation magnitude to expose the injected fault quickly.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 DRL accumulator：把每个 25 位加数先符号扩展到完整累加器宽度，再让 CSA tree 以这个完整有符号宽度工作。
why_it_counts: 提交标题直接指出是 accumulator bug。
RTL 补丁直接修改了累加器模块内部的算术位宽和符号扩展行为。
配套单元测试也开始计算并打印完整的累加器预算宽度，这与真实的算术正确性修复相一致。
evidence: hw/rtl/tcu/drl/VX_tcu_drl_acc.sv 新增参数 W 作为累加器宽度，并把 sigOut 扩成 W 位。
每个 25 位输入加数在进入 CSA tree 前都会显式扩成 sigsIn_ext。
VX_csa_tree 的参数从 W = 25 改成了 W = W 且 S = W - 1，因此归约树现在按完整累加器位宽工作。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 多操作数有符号累加器必须在归约前先把每个带符号部分和扩展到最终累加器位宽。如果设计在没有符号扩展的情况下直接累加窄位宽有符号操作数，或者 carry-save tree 本身仍停留在输入位宽而不是累加器位宽，那么负数项和大幅值求和都会出错。这是归约算术中典型的有符号位宽错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: CSA 累加前的有符号部分和扩宽
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 累加器收到负加数，或者收到一组真实和需要比单个输入更宽位宽才能表示的加数。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让窄位宽有符号加数在不扩宽的情况下进入归约树，并让树宽度绑定到输入宽度而不是累加器宽度。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何对多个有符号部分积求和的 compressor tree、CSA tree 或归约加法器。
该错误的本质是操作数解释位宽与累加器预算位宽不匹配。
在存在负部分和或接近最坏幅值组合时，该故障最容易观察到。
concrete_injection_steps: 删除每个有符号加数进入多操作数归约结构前的显式符号扩展。
把 CSA 或 compressor tree 的参数宽度改回原始操作数位宽，而不是完整累加器位宽。
保持输出接口位宽仍然较宽，使算术错误表现为符号或数值错误，而不是单纯的接口截断。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DRL significand accumulator 的符号扩展与 CSA-tree 位宽
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复先把每个 25 位加数符号扩展到计算得到的累加器位宽 W，再让 CSA tree 在这个完整位宽上工作。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_tcu_drl_acc.sv 中删除 sigsIn_ext，让树直接消费原始 25 位 sigsIn，并把树参数改回接近 W = 25 的旧配置。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 累加器会产生错误的符号或幅值，尤其是在求和负部分积或真实和超过窄输入位宽时。
evidence_for_injection: 修复新增了独立的累加器位宽参数，而不是只改注释或测试。
树前新增的唯一本质数据通路逻辑就是符号扩展，这清楚标明了此前缺失的算术行为。
树宽度从固定 25 位改成 W 位，说明之前的归约位宽确实不够。
notes: 这是非常直接的 reverse-patch 候选，因为算术变异集中在单个模块内。
使用含负加数和接近最坏累加幅值的测试，可以很快暴露该故障。
